Aggregates code violation records by tract for 2024 and 2025, computes the year-over-year increase, joins tract names, and ranks all Montgomery tracts by that increase descending.
sql:
WITH obs AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violations_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_45fc20'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND year IN (2024, 2025)
    AND geoid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  (COALESCE(o.violations_2025, 0) - COALESCE(o.violations_2024, 0)) AS increase_in_code_violations,
  COALESCE(o.violations_2024, 0) AS violations_2024,
  COALESCE(o.violations_2025, 0) AS violations_2025,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN obs o ON o.geoid = t.geoid
ORDER BY increase_in_code_violations DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
